pages.text: Elements are the universal currency and energy of your magical town.

Elements come in 7 types (Earth, Water, Fire, Wind, Light, Dark, Arcane) and cannot be directly converted into one another.$(br2)Check current reserves and generation rates in the $(l:wandscape:building/warehouse_guide)Warehouse$(/l) or the top bar of the V-panel.
pages.title: Elemental Currency

pages.text: Each building card displays three key rating icons:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Satisfaction (Green)$(): Influences tourist mood and stay duration.$(li)$(bold)Magic (Blue)$(): Affects spell efficiency and high-tier visitor rates.$(li)$(bold)Wonder (Yellow)$(): Represents decoration and scale, driving town tier upgrades.
